$comment: Seed settings for the 'Local' (llama.cpp) worker's isolated home,
A 27B model with a 98k window cannot afford the full harness: the
36 default tool schemas measured 83.7KB, of which Workflow alone was
21KB. Everything below is denied to keep the per-request overhead
small and to leave the model a tool set it can actually aim at.
Denied here rather than in permissions.ask so the schemas never reach
the request in the first place.
